title: Gedaliah Murdered

questions.question: In what month of the year did Ishmael the son of Nethaniah come to Gedaliah at Mizpah with ten men?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 41:1 (ESV): "In the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, son of Elishama, of the royal family... came with ten men to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, at Mizpah."

questions.question: What was the royal connection of Ishmael the son of Nethaniah?
options: He was of the royal family, one of the chief officers of the king
He was a descendant of the high priest
He was a prince of the Ammonites
He was a former king of Edom
questions.correctAnswer: He was of the royal family, one of the chief officers of the king
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 41:1 (ESV): "of the royal family, one of the chief officers of the king,"

questions.question: What were Ishmael and Gedaliah doing when Ishmael rose up and struck Gedaliah down?
options: Eating bread together there at Mizpah
questions.correctAnswer: Eating bread together there at Mizpah
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 41:1-2 (ESV): "As they ate bread together there at Mizpah, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah and the ten men with him rose up and struck down Gedaliah..."

questions.question: Who else did Ishmael strike down along with Gedaliah?
options: All the Judeans who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, and the Chaldean soldiers who happened to be there
questions.correctAnswer: All the Judeans who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, and the Chaldean soldiers who happened to be there
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 41:3 (ESV): "Ishmael also struck down all the Judeans who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah, and the Chaldean soldiers who happened to be there."

questions.question: On the day after the murder of Gedaliah (before anyone knew of it), eighty men arrived from Shechem, Shiloh, and Samaria. What did they bring?
options: Grain offerings and incense to present at the temple of the Lord
Tribute gold for the king of Babylon
questions.correctAnswer: Grain offerings and incense to present at the temple of the Lord
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 41:4-5 (ESV): "eighty men arrived from Shechem and Shiloh and Samaria, with their beards shaved and their clothes torn, and their bodies gashed, bringing grain offerings and incense to present at the temple of the Lord."

questions.question: How did Ishmael approach the eighty men as he went out to meet them?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 41:6 (ESV): "And Ishmael the son of Nethaniah came out from Mizpah to meet them, weeping as he came. As he met them, he said to them, 'Come in to Gedaliah the son of Ahikam.'"

questions.question: When the eighty men came into the city, what did Ishmael and the men with him do to them?
options: They slaughtered them and cast them into a cistern
They forced them to become slaves
They stole their offerings and let them go
questions.correctAnswer: They slaughtered them and cast them into a cistern
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 41:7 (ESV): "Ishmael the son of Nethaniah and the men with him slaughtered them and cast them into a cistern."

questions.question: Why were ten of the eighty men spared?
options: They told Ishmael they had stores of wheat, barley, oil, and honey hidden in the fields
They belonged to his own tribe
They agreed to swear allegiance to him
They were prophets of the Lord
questions.correctAnswer: They told Ishmael they had stores of wheat, barley, oil, and honey hidden in the fields
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 41:8 (ESV): "But there were ten men among them who said to Ishmael, 'Do not put us to death, for we have stores of wheat, barley, oil, and honey hidden in the fields.' So he refrained..."

questions.question: The cistern where Ishmael cast the bodies of the murdered men had originally been made by whom for defense against Baasha king of Israel?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 41:9 (ESV): "the cistern was the large one that King Asa had made for defense against Baasha king of Israel;"

questions.question: After the slaughter, what did Ishmael do with the rest of the people left in Mizpah, including the king's daughters?
options: He took them captive and set out to cross over to the Ammonites
He forced them to rebuild the walls
questions.correctAnswer: He took them captive and set out to cross over to the Ammonites
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 41:10 (ESV): "Then Ishmael took captive all the rest of the people who were in Mizpah... Ishmael the son of Nethaniah took them captive and set out to cross over to the Ammonites."

questions.question: Who heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done?
options: Johanan the son of Kareah and all the leaders of the forces
questions.correctAnswer: Johanan the son of Kareah and all the leaders of the forces
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 41:11 (ESV): "But when Johanan the son of Kareah and all the leaders of the forces with him heard of all the evil that Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had done,"

questions.question: Where did Johanan and his men overtake Ishmael and the captives?
options: By the great pool that is in Gibeon
At the ford of the Jabbok
questions.correctAnswer: By the great pool that is in Gibeon
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 41:12 (ESV): "they took all their men and went to fight against Ishmael the son of Nethaniah. They came upon him at the great pool that is in Gibeon."

questions.question: How did the people whom Ishmael had taken captive react when they saw Johanan?
options: They were glad, and turned around and joined Johanan
They were terrified he would kill them
They thought he was part of the Babylonian army
questions.correctAnswer: They were glad, and turned around and joined Johanan
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 41:13-14 (ESV): "And when all the people who were with Ishmael saw Johanan... they were glad. So all the people whom Ishmael had carried away captive from Mizpah turned around and came back, and went to Johanan the son of Kareah."

questions.question: What happened to Ishmael?
options: He escaped from Johanan with eight men and went to the Ammonites
He was struck down by Johanan
He was taken captive and sent to Babylon
He drowned in the great pool
questions.correctAnswer: He escaped from Johanan with eight men and went to the Ammonites
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 41:15 (ESV): "But Ishmael the son of Nethaniah escaped from Johanan with eight men, and went to the Ammonites."

questions.question: After recovering the captives, where did Johanan and his forces stay, intending to go to Egypt?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah 41:17 (ESV): "And they went and stayed at Geruth Chimham near Bethlehem, intending to go to Egypt"

key_verse_text: Then Ishmael took captive all the rest of the people who were in Mizpah, the king's daughters and all the people who were left at Mizpah... Ishmael the son of Nethaniah took them captive and set out to cross over to the Ammonites.
